list.description: Optional: the net.anisota.feed.list this hand files to by default. The hand does not draw cards from the list; it is where 'file' sends them.

name.description: Display name. Absent on the default hand, which the client names.

updatedAt.description: When the hand was last renamed or re-tied.

description.description: Optional description of what this hand is for.

main.description: A hand: posts drawn aside to act on later. On the card table it is the tray along the bottom edge and the place a card lands when it is dragged down. Membership is net.anisota.feed.listItem records whose `list` is this record's AT-URI, exactly as for net.anisota.feed.list, so a hand and a list hold cards the same way and a card moves between them by re-pointing its item. The record at rkey `self` is the default hand every account has; other hands use tid keys. Readers of net.anisota.feed.list never surface hands, and readers of this collection show `self` first. The repo is public, as every collection here is.
